description: This file defines a RedisService class for interacting with Redis using the ioredis library within a NestJS application. It manages Redis connection lifecycle, provides methods for common Redis operations (get, set, delete, list, expire, increment), and handles connection events and errors.

classes.name: RedisService
classes.description: A service class for managing Redis operations, connection lifecycle, and error handling within a NestJS module.

methods.name: onModuleDestroy
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the Redis connection when the module is destroyed.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from Redis by key, parsing JSON if applicable.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a value in Redis with optional TTL.

methods.name: expire
methods.description: Sets expiration time for a key.

methods.name: lrange
methods.description: Retrieves a list of items from a Redis list, parsing JSON if applicable.

methods.name: lpush
methods.description: Pushes elements onto a Redis list, serializing objects as JSON.

methods.name: incr
methods.description: Increments a numeric value stored at key.
